shipping_help.title: Warum sollte ich Lieferungen zusammenlegen?
shipping_help.html:
Das Zusammenlegen mehrerer Artikel aus Ihrem Lager gewährleistet nicht nur eine professionelle Verpackung, sondern hilft auch, im Vergleich zu separaten Sendungen internationale Versandkosten zu sparen.


Ein Beispiel für die Auswahl von GD-EMS für den Versand in die USA:
Angenommen, das Grundgewicht beträgt 500 g und kostet 30 USD, jedes weitere 500 g kostet 10 USD, und die Bearbeitungsgebühr beträgt 1 USD pro Paket.

Angenommen, Sie haben 3 Artikel mit einem Gewicht von jeweils 700 g, 1100 g und 1600 g.

  1. Wenn Sie sich für den regulären Versand entscheiden (bei dem die Pakete einzeln versendet werden), betragen die Kosten 153 USD.

(30 + 10 + 1) + (30 + 10 × 2 + 1) + (30 + 10 × 3 + 1) = 153 USD

  1. Wenn Sie die Option des Kombiversands wählen, betragen die Versandkosten nur 91 USD.

Das Gesamtgewicht des Pakets berechnet sich wie folgt: 700 g + 1100 g + 1600 g = 3400 g.

Versandkosten: 30 + 10 × 6 + 1 = 91 USD

Das Zusammenlegen der Sendungen spart Ihnen die Kosten für 2 Grundgewichte plus 2 Bearbeitungsgebühren und somit direkt 62 USD an Versandkosten.

153 – 91 = 62 USD


Tipp:
Das Gewicht und die Menge eines Pakets sind wichtige Faktoren, die verschiedene Länder zur Unterscheidung zwischen persönlicher und kommerzieller Sendung heranziehen. Pakete über 10 kg werden eher als kommerziell eingestuft, und eine große Menge desselben Artikels ist ein weiterer wesentlicher Grund für die Einstufung als kommerzielle Sendung. Daher empfehlen wir, Gewicht und Anzahl der Artikel bei der Auswahl der Option zum Zusammenlegen mehrerer Artikel für den Versand zu berücksichtigen.

shipping_help.title: Compensation standard for insured parcel
shipping_help.html:
1. Compensation Details

If your package is lost/damaged, delayed, seized by customs, etc., and you have purchased package insurance when submitting the waybill, we will compensate according to the actual shipping cost of the package + the actual value of the product, and the compensation cap would be the insured amount.

2. Compensation Standard

Disclaimer:

  1. 1.Lost/Damaged Insurance Disclaimer: Parcel lost/damage caused by the recipient, and the parcel is returned to the logistics provider’s overseas warehouse or destroyed by the logistics provider due to the recipient’s failure to sign for the parcel in time, are uncovered in the scope of lost/damage compensation.
  2. 2.Customs Seizure Insurance Disclaimer: Parcel confiscated caused by the recipient’s failure to cooperate with local customs clearance or tax payment, etc., are uncovered in the scope of customs seizure compensation.
  3. 3.Force Majeure: Including but not limited to war, natural disaster(earthquake, cyclone, storm, flood, etc.), nuclear radiation, nuclear explosion, nuclear contamination, and other radioactive contamination.
  4. 4.Customers can not provide related proof.
  5. 5.Exceeding the application deadline(no inquiry or no compensation request after signed within 7 days or shipped within 45 days ), or the parcel was delivered during the application time.
  6. 6.The parcel was stolen or missing for certain reasons after delivery.
  7. 7.Products related to Non- Insurable categories, items in violation of the prohibition or restriction for delivery, confiscated by the competent authority or dealt with in accordance with relevant laws &regulations.
  8. 8.The parcel was damaged or lost due to the customers’ responsibility, deliberate actions, or the product itself a reason.
  9. 9.The amount of compensation for forwarding orders does not exceed the value declared by the customer.
  10. 10.Other situations that can not apply for compensation.

How to Apply for Insurance Claims?
Contact our online customer service.


OrientDig reserves the right to the final interpretation of the above content. Thank you for your understanding

coupon_help.title: Affiliate system rules
coupon_help.html:
1. What can I use my invitation link and the affiliate share link from the product page for?

As a promoter, you can share your invitation link and affiliate share link. Anyone who signs up for a OrientDig account on PC through these channels will become your affiliate and contribute to your affiliation bonus.

2. How to get your claimable bonus?

OrientDig will credit the bonus to your [Claimable Bonus] once your affiliated users’ parcels have been delivered.

3. Claimable Bonus Rate Rules.

Basic Affiliate Promoter: Earn 3% of the parcel shipping fee after delivery.
Bronze Affiliate Promoter: Earn 4% of the parcel shipping fee after delivery.
Silver Affiliate Promoter: Earn 5% of the parcel shipping fee after delivery.
Gold Affiliate Promoter: Earn 6% of the parcel shipping fee after delivery.
Platinum Affiliate Promoter: Earn 7% of the parcel shipping fee after delivery.

4. How is my bonus calculated?

As soon as you become a member, your account will immediately receive a 3% rebate rate. The more users you invite to register with international logistics freight, the higher your bonuses and rebate rate will become. Once your bonus reaches a certain threshold, you can either withdraw it or use it to offset any service fees on the OrientDig platform.
Basic Affiliate: 0 Point.
Bronze Affiliate: 5,000 Points.
Silver Affiliate: 20,000 Points.
Gold Affiliate: 80,000 Points.
Platinum Affiliate: 400,000 Points.
